sources.text: Hero video: RS-25 engine test, NASA Stennis Space Center, 20 June 2025. NASA.
sources.note: Link supplied by Kari on 2026-10-06 as the place the clip was downloaded from. Centre and date are read from the item's identifier (SSC = Stennis Space Center, 2025-06-20); the burnt-in timecode in the shot starts with day 171, which is 20 June. The item page itself was not read when this was written.

stages.note: New file names on purpose: Cloudflare caches .mp4 at the edge for a day, and a new name needs no purge. The first cut's files (hero.mp4, hero_poster.webp) were removed from the working tree in the same commit; they remain in the branch history. The files were encoded on Kari's computer on purpose: a first copy encoded in the assistant's cloud workspace and sent over arrived with a C2PA content-credentials block (claim generator Anthropic) added by the transfer channel, 5.9 KB in the mp4 and 5.8 KB in the WebP. Media files for the site should not travel through that channel; text files arrive unchanged.
stages.by: Claude, at Kari's request ('web-optimised, keep the quality')
stages.tool: ffmpeg 4.4.2 (libx264, libwebp), run on Kari's computer in the assistant's local sandbox, straight from the cut to the repository folder
stages.command: ffmpeg -i hero_v3_rs25.mp4 -an -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 22 -profile:v high -level 4.0 -pix_fmt yuv420p -g 60 -keyint_min 30 -colorspace bt709 -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -color_range tv -movflags +faststart hero_v3.mp4 ; ffmpeg -i hero_v3_rs25.mp4 -frames:v 1 -c:v libwebp -quality 86 -compression_level 6 hero_poster_v3.webp
stages.fidelity: Against the cut it was made from: mean PSNR 45.7 dB, SSIM 0.990 (per shot: Apollo 50.2 dB, RS-25 43.3 dB, detonation engine 47.9 dB; lowest single frame 39.3 dB, right after the cut at 6.1 s). CRF 20 gave 16.3 MB / 47.0 dB and CRF 24 9.7 MB / 44.5 dB; 22 was the smallest that still looked identical at 2x enlargement on the hardest frames.
